prompt: Set up a pencil design system in this project. The repo currently has no design-system/ folder.

assertions.text: Confirms with the user before scaffolding (or proceeds because the user explicitly asked)
Names all 7 templates: README.md, design-system.md, tokens.md, components.md, layout.md, voice.md, code-export.md
Indicates the templates come from the skill's assets/design-system/ directory
Targets design-system/ at the project root (not pencil/, not pen-design-system/)
Mentions collision detection — what to do if design-system/ already exists with code
Tells the user which file(s) to fill in first (design-system.md and/or tokens.md typically)
Mentions that tokens.md / design-system.md contain placeholders the user must replace
Mentions the seven-file pattern is read progressively (README first, then others on demand)
